column1: Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14

B
Y virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 163 and 324 of Block 01,
contained in the Cadastral Map No. 510224, situated in the Village of Yapalana within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 40 - Gane-
goda in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Meerigama, in the District of Gampaha, in the Province of Western, referred to in Notice
No. 51/0171 calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 1624/27 of 22nd October, 2009 in terms of
Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
